subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Liable
solution: The correct answer is **"Invulnerable."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Liable"** means responsible or legally bound to do something. (कुछ करने की संभावना से युक्त) • **Example**: *We’re all **liable**__ to fall asleep while driving when we are very tired.* • Antonym of **liable** is **invulnerable**. • **"Invulnerable"** means unable to be harmed or damaged. (क्षति पहुँचाने या क्षति पहुँचाने में असमर्थ) __ • **Example**: *No state in the region is now **invulnerable**__ to attack by another.* • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1 - Peaceful**: This word is not opposite to liable as it does not convey any sense of responsibility or obligation. (शांतिपूर्ण; युद्घ, हिंसा या तर्क-वितर्क हीन) • **Option 3 - Tending**: This word means taking care of or looking after, which is not opposite to liable. (मांसपेशियों का कड़ा पड़ जाना और तन जाना) • **Option 4 - Responsible**: This word is a synonym of liable, not an antonym. It means having an obligation to do something or being accountable for something. (उत्तरदायी, ज़िम्‍मेदार, जवाबदेह (किसी के प्रति, किसी काम के लिए)) 2f:Td07, The correct answer is **"site."**
